You hear a noise behind you and spin around, but you can't see anything other than a fridge. You shudder, but continue examining the room. You can make out an oven. You make out a table. The table is massive. But the thing is empty, unfortunately. Oh! Why couldn't there just be stuff on it? You can see a counter. Looks like someone's already been here and taken everything off it, though. It would have been so cool if there was stuff on the counter! oh well. You see a stove. You wonder idly who left that here. But the thing is empty, unfortunately.

There is a closed frosted-glass door leading east. You need an exit without a door? You should try going south. There is an exit to the west.

There is a white onion, a banana, a red onion and a red apple on the floor.
inventory: You are carrying: a raw yellow potato, a raw red potato, a knife and a cookbook.

thought: Now I will take the red onion from the floor to have all the necessary ingredients.
feedback: You pick up the red onion from the ground.

---------

banana
  block of cheese
  orange bell pepper
  white onion
  pork chop

Directions:
chop the banana
  grill the banana
  slice the block of cheese
  grill the block of cheese
  dice the orange bell pepper
  roast the orange bell pepper
  dice the white onion
  fry the white onion
  slice the pork chop
  roast the pork chop
  prepare meal
